subject: Whole-module parity probe HARNESS_HOLD; GPU released
body: Whole Qwen3.5 module parity probe exited before backend execution because apply_qwen35_acceleration discovers modules by names ending .linear_attn and the probe passed the GatedDeltaNet module as root. This is a probe-harness structural mismatch, not a causal-conv parity result. No weights changed. GPU released. Fix: wrap each probe module under a real-model-like layer.linear_attn path, keep thresholds/backend subject unchanged, rerun exact gate.
